{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for thousands separators in 'revenue'
print("First 5 rows of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"\nDoes 'revenue' contain commas? {has_commas}")

# Check for the six QA orders with 999999.99
print(f"\nNumber of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]}")"}
